meta.name: RECURRENCE_V2_SEED
meta.description: Hash-accelerated structural closure detection for Rule 2.2
invariants: Closure detection uses pattern matching, NOT Python conditionals
Seen-set entries store {state_hash, state} pairs for O(1) hash comparison
Hash comparison via non-linear pattern (same hash var bound twice)
Pre-computed mu_hash boundary primitive enables hash-accelerated lookup
Non-linear patterns enforced by bootstrap_structural binding conflict detection
kernel_requirements: bootstrap_structural.v1.json (5 projections) for non-linear pattern support

projections.description: Initialize closure detection state from trace result
Reached end of trace (null) without finding closure
Extract state and state_hash from stall entry (has extra 'stall' key)
Extract state and state_hash from max_steps entry (has extra 'max_steps' key)
Extract state and state_hash from current trace entry and check against seen-set
Hash found in seen-set (non-linear match: same 'hash' var bound from _state_hash and _check_list head) -> closure detected!
Hash not in seen-set head (different var 'other_hash' vs 'hash'), continue checking tail
Exhausted check_list (null) without match -> add {state_hash, state} to seen, advance
Extract final closure detection result with tau_step for exhaustion
